title: Alsace entity who said the witness had the time wrong and asked if this was Italy or Germany

tellings.quote: right then he says am I in Italy or Germany witness says you're in alzace

plain: Jacques Vallee, a researcher who has spent decades collecting UFO reports, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of a witness in Alsace, a region of eastern France, who met a strange being. According to Vallee, the being told the witness he had the time wrong and then asked whether he was in Italy or Germany, and the witness answered that he was in Alsace. Vallee tells it because odd, absurd details like this keep turning up in encounter stories.
